name: citeworthy
description: An agent skill marketplace that audits any website for the problems that stop AI assistants finding, reading, quoting and correctly describing a brand, and that stop visitors engaging once they arrive. Emits a single evidence-backed report of findings, severities and prioritized fixes.

skills.summary: Receives the audit request, runs every other skill in causal order, applies the cross-skill gating/confounding/linking/prioritisation rules, and emits the single validated audit report.

Can a crawler reach the site at all? Distinguishes answer-time retrieval agents from training-corpus crawlers, checks robots/sitemaps/status/canonicals/snippet directives, and produces the shared evidence bundle every other skill reads.
Can a machine read what a human sees? Measures the raw-HTML vs rendered-DOM gap and finds facts locked in JavaScript, images, PDFs, video and iframes.
Are the facts machine-readable? Checks schema.org presence, validity, and agreement with the visible page.
Are the facts quotable? Checks whether the prose contains self-contained, declarative, bounded, specific sentences a retriever can lift as an answer.
Does the wider web agree? Audits on-site identity anchors, then probes search to test entity ambiguity, misrepresentation and independent corroboration.
Are the facts still true, and can a machine tell? Separates undatable content from stale content from dishonest freshness signals.
Does the arriving visitor stay? Framed around AI-referral traffic: cold arrivals on inner pages with a specific intent and no session history.

optional_dependencies.name: playwright
optional_dependencies.purpose: Renders pages so the raw-HTML vs rendered-DOM gap can be measured rather than inferred. Without it, render findings are reported as explicitly-labelled heuristics at reduced confidence.

safety.authenticated_areas: never fetched (filtered by URL path and subdomain)
safety.network_requests: GET only, rate-limited, concurrency-capped, bounded by pages/depth/time
